title: Prudence
competency: Explain prudence and practise wise decisions.

keywords.def: Practical wisdom: thinking before acting, avoiding unnecessary risk, planning for the future.

en.text: Prudence is the ability to make sound decisions to avoid danger or risk: care, caution, good judgement and foresight. A prudent person thinks before acting, asks what is right and kind, learns from mistakes and plans for both the short and long term.

screens.title: Prudence
paras: Prudence is the ability to make sound decisions to avoid danger or risk.
It is care, caution, good judgement and foresight.
It is also called practical wisdom.
It includes both short-term and long-term planning.
screens.note: A prudent person thinks before deciding, asks "What is the right and kind thing to do?" and learns from past mistakes.
